# Interferon response partial fabrication variant B

The type-I interferon program showed broad activation. IFI6 was downregulated in the treated arm (Table 1). ISG15 was upregulated (Table 1). MX1 was upregulated (Table 1). OAS1 was upregulated (Table 1). IFI44 was upregulated (Table 1).

IRF7 was upregulated (Table 1). TNF was downregulated (Table 1). IL6 was downregulated (Table 1). HMOX1 was upregulated (Table 1).
